people.name: Developer
people.description:
- Annotates their codebase and scans it into a workspace
- Imports it into SeeForce, then explores and enriches the diagram
- Opens share links to other people's diagrams, read-only
people.short_desc: Maps a codebase, then explores and enriches the diagram

relationships.description:
- signs in with GitHub
- imports workspaces
- explores and edits diagrams
- opens share links

softwareSystems.name: SeeForce
softwareSystems.description:
- Turns C4 annotations in a codebase's source files into an interactive architecture diagram
- Shows what a pull request changes in that architecture
- Answers "what does this codebase actually do, and how do its pieces talk to each other?"
softwareSystems.short_desc: Turns C4 annotations in your code into an interactive architecture diagram

relationships.description:
- signs users in with OAuth
- fetches repo content with installation tokens
- lists and reads pull requests for the delta view
relationships.short_desc: signs users in, fetches repos and PRs

containers.name: Database
containers.description:
- Stores projects and their workspace.json
- Stores node/edge overlays and lexicon entries
- Stores share tokens and project access
- Stores users' GitHub App installations
containers.short_desc: Stores projects, overlays, lexicon and access

containers.name: Backend
containers.description:
- Serves the REST API for:
  - Project CRUD
  - Node/edge overlays
  - Lexicon entries
  - Share links
  - Pull request architecture deltas
  - GitHub:
    - Import
    - Sync
    - Link
- Persists data in the Database
containers.short_desc: Serves the REST API behind the app and stores every project

relationships.description: reads and writes architecture graph data

- signs users in with OAuth
- fetches repo content with installation tokens
- lists and reads pull requests for the delta view
relationships.short_desc: signs users in, fetches repos and PRs

relationships.description: builds workspace.json on manage.py scan

components.name: Delta Presenter
components.description:
- Takes the base and head workspace.json, their comparison, and the level to show
- Returns that level's graph as React Flow nodes and edges, each with a `delta` field:
  - its state: added, removed, modified or unchanged
  - the fields that changed, a description with its capability diff
- Marks a container or system modified when something inside it changed
- Adds removed elements and relations back as ghost nodes and edges, so they keep a position
- Returns a `summary`: the change counts and the full list of changes
components.short_desc: Builds the compared graph of one level, with each node's and edge's change

relationships.description:
- renders the level's nodes and edges from the head workspace
- builds the ghost nodes
relationships.short_desc: renders the view, builds ghost nodes

relationships.description: reads the added, removed and changed elements and relations, with each description's capability diff

components.name: GitHub App Token Manager
components.description:
- Signs a JWT with the GitHub App's private key
- Exchanges it for a 1h installation access token
- Caches each token for 50 minutes so a burst of calls mints once
components.short_desc: Mints and caches short-lived GitHub App installation tokens

relationships.description:
- exchanges the signed app JWT for an installation token
- reads the installation's owning account
relationships.short_desc: mints installation tokens, reads their owner

components.name: Graph transformer
components.description:
- Converts a stored workspace.json into ReactFlow nodes and edges for one C1/C2/C3 view
- Applies the project's node and edge overlays
- Adds placeholder nodes for relationship targets outside the view
- Sizes each node by its lines of code, relative to the other nodes of the view
components.short_desc: Converts workspace.json into ReactFlow nodes and edges per view

relationships.description: merges the labels of parallel edges into one list of flows

components.name: Local Scan Command
components.description:
- Runs `manage.py scan` on one or more local repo paths
- Creates or updates the scanned project's ProjectMap
components.short_desc: Scans local repo paths and upserts the resulting ProjectMap

relationships.description:
- parses annotation blocks from the target repo path(s)
- counts the lines of code of each source file

- resolves relationships
- assembles the parsed elements into workspace.json
creates or updates the ProjectMap row for the scanned project

components.name: Auth API
components.description:
- Serves the auth endpoints:
  - /api/auth/me/ session check
  - /api/auth/logout/
- Reports whether the user has a GitHub App installation
- Returns the GitHub App install/configure URL
components.short_desc: Checks the session, logs out and reports GitHub App status

relationships.description:
- logs users in with OAuth 2.0
- resolves their GitHub identity
reads the user's GitHub SocialAccount and GitHubAppInstallation rows

components.name: Delta View API
components.description:
- Lists the linked repository's open pull requests
- Fetches workspace.json from GitHub at the pull request's base and head commits
- Compares the two snapshots
- Returns the decorated C1/C2/C3 view of that comparison
- Reads the repository with the requesting user's own installation token
- Caches each commit's workspace.json in memory for a day, keyed by token
components.short_desc: Serves open pull requests and the decorated delta view

relationships.description:
- resolves the installation token
- fetches workspace.json at the base and head commits

- lists the repository's open pull requests
- reads one pull request by number
hands it the base and head workspace.json to compare
hands it both workspaces and their comparison, gets back the level's graph with change states
reads node and edge overlays so the compared view keeps authored labels
reads the ProjectMap row the comparison is requested for

components.name: GitHub App Setup Endpoint
components.description:
- Receives GitHub's post-install and post-update redirect
- Verifies the installation belongs to the logged-in user's GitHub account
- Links the installation to that SeeForce user
components.short_desc: Handles GitHub's post-install redirect and links the installation

relationships.description: reads the installation's owning GitHub account
creates or updates the GitHubAppInstallation row for the logged-in user

components.name: GitHub Import
components.description:
- Imports, re-syncs and links a project to a GitHub repository
- Picks the user's installation matching the repo owner, falling back to public access
- Stores the fetched .seeforce/workspace.json as a ProjectMap
- Caches reads pinned to a commit for a day, keyed by token
components.short_desc: Imports, re-syncs, and links project architecture from GitHub

relationships.description: fetches .seeforce/workspace.json through the Contents API
Requests the installation token before each Contents API call
creates or updates the ProjectMap row for the imported, synced, or linked repo

components.name: Edit API
components.description:
- Saves user edits on a project map:
  - Node description overlays
  - Edge label overlays
  - Lexicon entries
- Serves project CRUD
- Serves the rendered graph for a given C4 level
components.short_desc: Saves user edits and serves project CRUD and graph views

relationships.description: reads and writes ProjectMap, NodeOverlay, EdgeOverlay, and LexiconEntry rows
converts the requested project's workspace.json into ReactFlow nodes/edges for the view endpoint

containers.name: SeeForce CLI
containers.description:
- Logs in to SeeForce
- Scans a repo's annotations into workspace.json
- Compares workspaces across revisions and checks the feature catalogue
- Starts an annotation pass in the user's AI assistant
- Installs the MCP server and the drift-sync tooling (Stop hook, skill, CLAUDE.md rule)
containers.short_desc: Logs in, scans repos and installs the drift-sync tooling

relationships.description:
- builds workspace.json on `seeforce scan`
- compares snapshots on `seeforce delta`

- authenticates the user
- fetches the project id the MCP server registers against

components.name: Annotate Command
components.description:
- Runs `seeforce annotate`
- Prints how to start an annotation pass in the user's own coding assistant
components.short_desc: Prints how to start an annotation pass in the user's AI assistant

relationships.description: names the server the assistant fetches the annotation guide from

components.name: Delta Command
components.description:
- Runs `seeforce delta` between two git revisions
- Reads the base workspace.json from git at the base revision, the head one from the working tree
- Prints what changed in the architecture
- Reports every catalogue feature that lost an element
- Exits 1 on a broken feature, 2 on a bad revision or load, 0 otherwise
components.short_desc: Compares two revisions' workspaces and fails CI on a broken feature

relationships.description:
- hands it the base and head workspace.json to compare
- finds the catalogue features that lost an element
loads and validates the working tree's catalogue against the head snapshot

components.name: Features Command
components.description:
- Runs `seeforce features`
- Validates the catalogue against the working tree's model
- Lists what the repo lets you do, capabilities and prerequisites apart
- Exits 2 on a validation failure or a missing model
components.short_desc: Validates the feature catalogue and lists what the repo lets you do

relationships.description: loads and validates the catalogue against the scanned workspace

components.name: Login Command
components.description:
- Runs `seeforce login` through the GitHub OAuth flow
- Receives the callback on a short-lived local server
- Stores the API url and token in the user's config
components.short_desc: Authenticates via GitHub OAuth and stores the API token locally

relationships.description:
- runs the OAuth exchange
- returns the API token
relationships.short_desc: exchanges OAuth code for the API token

components.name: MCP Install Command
components.description:
- Registers the SeeForce MCP server in ~/.claude.json
- Writes the drift-sync tooling into the target repo:
  - arch-sync-check.sh Stop hook
  - seeforce-arch-check skill
  - CLAUDE.md rule section
- Refreshes both on `update`, without re-running onboarding
components.short_desc: Registers and refreshes the MCP server plus the drift-sync hook/skill

relationships.description:
- fetches the project id
- validates the auth token

components.name: Scan Command
components.description:
- Runs `seeforce scan` over the repo
- Writes .seeforce/workspace.json
- Prints advisory warnings: orphans, empty containers, unreadable descriptions
- Exits non-zero on a parse error or an unresolved reference
components.short_desc: Scans the repo for annotations and writes .seeforce/workspace.json

relationships.description:
- parses the annotation blocks out of the repo's source files
- counts the lines of code of each source file

- resolves the references between parsed elements
- assembles the workspace

containers.name: MCP Server
containers.description:
- Serves architecture context to AI coding assistants over MCP (stdio):
  - System overview and component search
  - File ownership and drift checks for edited files
  - Static import facts for files
- Serves the guides for writing annotations and a feature catalogue
- Ships as the seeforce-mcp entry point of the seeforce-cli package
containers.short_desc: Exposes SeeForce architecture context to AI coding assistants via MCP

relationships.description: fetches workspace architecture data

components.name: Workspace API Client
components.description:
- Fetches the project's workspace.json from the Backend
- Picks the project from the configured UUID, else the most recently updated one
components.short_desc: Fetches the current project's workspace.json from the Backend

relationships.description: fetches workspace architecture data

components.name: Ownership Inference
components.description:
- Infers the C4 component or container that owns a file path, by:
  - Exact source_file match
  - Same-directory proximity
  - Nearest annotated parent directory
components.short_desc: Finds which component or container owns a file

components.name: Tool Handlers
components.description:
- Answers the MCP tools assistants call:
  - get_context: system overview
  - find_component: search by keyword
  - get_file_owner: component owning a file
  - get_architecture_for_files: drift check for edited files
- Serves the guides behind annotate_codebase and catalogue_features
components.short_desc: Implements the MCP tools assistants call to query architecture

relationships.description: fetches workspace architecture data

components.name: Static Facts Query Handler
components.description:
- Implements the get_static_facts_for_files MCP tool
- Collapses import facts into component-level candidate edges
- Drops edges between files of the same component
components.short_desc: Answers get_static_facts_for_files with candidate edges

relationships.description: fetches the workspace to resolve candidate edges to known components
extracts imports, definitions, and docstrings for the requested files
resolves each candidate edge endpoint's owning component

containers.name: Frontend
containers.description:
- Renders a project's architecture graph
- Shows what a pull request changes in the architecture
- Lets users edit overlays, tags and lexicon entries
- Gates routes behind sign-in
containers.short_desc: Renders the architecture graph and handles auth-gated routing

relationships.description:
- fetches graph data
- manages the user session

components.name: Architecture Visualizer
components.description:
- Renders the C1/C2/C3 graph of a project
- Drills down from a node into the level below
- Shows the selected pull request's changes on the canvas
components.short_desc: Renders the graph and handles drill-down between C1/C2/C3 views

relationships.description: Renders C4 element nodes in the ReactFlow canvas
Renders directional relationship edges between nodes
opens the detail/edit panel for the clicked node or edge
mounts the control that picks which merge request the canvas is showing
mounts the comparison's change list and selects the node an item names

components.name: Change List
components.description:
- Lists every change of the selected merge request, at every C4 level
- Opens the element an item names, or says which level holds it
components.short_desc: Lists the whole comparison's changes, grouped by level

components.name: Comparison Selector
components.description:
- Lists the repository's open pull requests and the branch each targets
- Enters and leaves the comparison
- Names both commits being compared
- Explains the four state badges in a legend
- Says why no comparison is available when there is none
components.short_desc: Picks the pull request to compare and explains the states

relationships.description: lists the linked repository's open pull requests

components.name: Overlay Editor
components.description:
- Shows the selected node's or edge's name, description, tags and source link
- Shows what the selected pull request changed on it
- Saves overlay edits in edit mode
- Manages the lexicon terms found in the node's description
components.short_desc: Sidebar panel to view and edit a node or edge's overlay details

relationships.description: reads the shared glossary via context to find terms relevant to the node being edited

- saves node/edge overlay edits
- saves lexicon entry changes

components.name: Edge manager
components.description:
- Draws directional relationship edges between nodes
- Attaches each edge to the nearest border point of its nodes
- Thickens an edge with its number of actions
components.short_desc: Renders relationship edges between nodes with floating geometry

relationships.description: highlights and links glossary terms found in edge relationship labels

components.name: Node manager
components.description:
- Renders System, Container, Component, Person and External nodes
- Shows each node's name, technology and short description
- Scales a node and its text with its lines of code, from 1x to 2.4x
components.short_desc: Renders System/Container/Component nodes on the graph canvas

relationships.description: highlights and links glossary terms found in node description

components.name: Auth Context
components.description:
- Checks the session when the app loads
- Exposes the signed-in user and logout to the app
components.short_desc: React auth state — checks session on load, exposes logout

relationships.description:
- checks the session
- signs the user out

components.name: Lexicon
components.description:
- Loads the project's glossary
- Highlights glossary terms in node descriptions and edge labels
- Shows a term's definition in a bottom panel on click
components.short_desc: Per-project glossary — highlights and defines terms in the graph

relationships.description:
- fetches lexicon entries
- saves lexicon entry changes
injects lexicon context into the ReactFlow node tree

components.name: Project Workspace
components.description:
- Hosts the graph canvas for one project
- Keeps the current C4 level and drill-down target
- Resolves the project's GitHub repo and branch for source links
- Mints, copies and revokes share links
components.short_desc: Per-project screen — hosts the graph, share modal, and current C4 level

relationships.description: embeds the graph canvas for the level currently selected in the view store

- reads the repo and branch for source links
- mints, reads and revokes the share token
relationships.short_desc: reads source links, manages share token

components.name: Project Library
components.description:
- Lists owned and shared projects
- Creates a project from an uploaded workspace.json or a GitHub import
- Renames, deletes, re-syncs and links projects to repos
- Prompts the GitHub App install
components.short_desc: Lists projects and is where upload or GitHub import creates one

relationships.description:
- reads the signed-in user
- reads the GitHub App installation status
relationships.short_desc: reads user and GitHub App status

relationships.description:
- lists projects
- creates projects from an upload or a GitHub import
- renames and deletes projects
- re-syncs and links projects to repos

containers.name: Annotation Parser
containers.description:
- Parses @c1/@c2/@c3/@lexicon annotations from a repo's source files
- Assembles them into workspace.json
- Compares workspace snapshots and checks the feature catalogue
- Extracts static import facts and entry points from source files
- Ships as the standalone seeforce-c4parser package
containers.short_desc: Parses C4 annotations from source files into workspace.json

components.name: Workspace Builder
components.description:
- Resolves every uses: reference to an element id
- Assembles systems, people, containers, components, relationships and views into workspace.json
- Flags structural drift before the workspace is written:
  - Level-mixing and ambiguous references
  - Orphan elements and containers with no component
  - Unreadable descriptions
- Weighs each container and component by the lines of code of the files it owns
components.short_desc: Resolves relationships into workspace.json; the structural drift gate

components.name: Capabilities
components.description:
- Reads no file itself: works on the description text its caller hands it
- Parses a `- ` bullet description into a tree of capabilities
- Counts the leaves, since a parent bullet only groups its children
- Diffs two capability trees bullet by bullet:
  - added and removed bullets
  - reworded bullets, paired by text similarity at the same level
components.short_desc: Turns bullet descriptions into capabilities and diffs them

components.name: Delta Reporter
components.description:
- Compares the two workspace.json snapshots its caller hands it
- Reads each element's description and each edge's actions from them
- Pairs elements by kind and source file, so a rename reads as a rename
- Pairs the leftovers by kind and name, so a moved file reads as a move
- Renders the delta as markdown, one row per changed capability or action
- Reports catalogue features that lost an element
components.short_desc: Compares two workspace snapshots into an architecture delta

relationships.description: hands it each changed description's before and after text to diff

components.name: Entry Point Discovery
components.description:
- Lists every deterministic way into a repo:
  - HTTP routes and REST collections
  - CLI commands
  - MCP tools
  - Page routes
- Counts one router registration as one entry point
- Sorts the output so two runs agree byte for byte
components.short_desc: Extracts a repo's routes, commands and tools as sorted entry points

components.name: Feature Catalogue
components.description:
- Loads, validates and saves the feature catalogue
- Resolves each element a feature names against a workspace snapshot
- Refuses a catalogue with an unknown version or an unresolved element
- Merges regenerations without touching human-reviewed features
components.short_desc: Loads and validates the feature catalogue against a workspace snapshot

relationships.description: flattens a workspace snapshot into the element paths the catalogue resolves against

components.name: Annotation Scanner
components.description:
- Walks a repo's source files
- Parses @c1/@c2/@c3/@lexicon blocks from comments and docstrings into a flat element list
- Normalizes descriptions into `- ` bullet text
- Counts the non-blank lines of every source file it walks
components.short_desc: Walks source files and extracts @c1/@c2/@c3/@lexicon blocks

components.name: Static Facts Extractor
components.description:
- Extracts imports, top-level definitions and adjacent docstrings from Python and TypeScript
- Isolated behind extract_facts() so tree-sitter stays optional
components.short_desc: Extracts imports and definitions as candidate signals

softwareSystems.name: GitHub
softwareSystems.description:
- Hosts each repo's .seeforce/workspace.json, read on import and sync
- Signs SeeForce users in through OAuth 2.0
- Issues installation tokens for the SeeForce GitHub App
- Serves the pull requests compared in the delta view
- Serves the source files nodes link to
softwareSystems.short_desc: Hosts the scanned repos and signs SeeForce users in
